channels.rationale: Filename MMDDYYYY is a download attachment label only; not an official ISO export timestamp channel.
Response headers omit Last-Modified on both RCFE and ARF downloads.
HTTP Date is the response generation clock, not a dataset export date.
CSV header has no file_date column (unlike historical CHHS dumps).
Client download time must never substitute for an authoritative export date.
FacilityDetail payload exposes license/visit dates and CAPACITY/STATUS but no export-date or roster-version field.
No public OpenAPI document describing an export-date or dataset-version endpoint was found.

channels.observedValue: describes Download Data / Facility Detail; no ISO export date field
channels.rationale: Official PIN describes site features and five-year retention; it does not document an authoritative bulk-export ISO timestamp.
CHHS raw file_date text is not an ISO export date and is not the live DownloadStateData channel.

channels.channel: ArcGIS / publish.data.ca.gov layer edit / catalog update clocks
channels.rationale: Catalog update and GIS dataLastEdit clocks are not DownloadStateData export dates.

channels.channel: Verified official CDSS ISO export-timestamp channel
channels.rationale: No official CDSS channel returned a verified ISO export date for DownloadStateData in Phase 7 probes.
